bioconda.name: bioconductor-lpnet
bioconda.summary: Linear Programming Model for Network Inference

biotools.summary: lpNet aims at infering biological networks, in particular signaling and gene networks. For that it takes perturbation data, either steady-state or time-series, as input and generates an LP model which allows the inference of signaling networks. For parameter identification either leave-one-out cross-validation or stratified n-fold cross-validation can be used.
